test_command: cmake --build build --config Debug --target test_exe > $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Set-Location build/bin/Debug; ./test_exe.exe --gtest_filter=BuffStateTest.*

mutations.catches: a state imposed where no buff grants it and taken where one does
a state asked of one buff type, so a second buff granting it is not seen
a state added again at every update, so the creature's list grows without bound
a buff granted without the state it imposes
a removed buff leaving its state behind

mutations.original:
// Every buff left is live, loaded ones included, so the states are read from them now.
	sync_buff_states(creature);
mutations.catches: an expired buff leaving its state behind, and a loaded buff imposing none
